title: Pullman's conservatory arch drawn smooth, with its iron cresting
items: 1904, 18th Street east of Prairie: the Pullman conservatory's great pointed arch is now one smooth curve, as the 1894 plate and the c. 1897 photograph show it, where it was four flat facets a side; the transept and the dome round off with it.
A light iron cresting runs along the transept's crest, with a finial over its end and a small ornament over the arch's point, as the plate draws them. Their pattern and heights are reconstructed.
